summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 17, 2026 press release announcing a long-term tungsten concentrate offtake agreement with Wolfram Bergbau und Hütten AG, a Sandvik Group subsidiary. The take-or-pay contract covers a minimum of roughly 1,720 tonnes of contained WO3 recovered by retreating the Los Santos Mine tailings in western Spain, and includes a conditional pay-to-play upfront US$3.0 million one-time payment for offtake rights plus index-linked pricing with a floor. It anticipates restart of the plant, in care and maintenance since February 2020. This is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation.
